import time
import os

# Load application
spm = nanosurf.SPM()
application = spm.application
scan = application.Scan

# Get current working directory
cwd = os.getcwd()
print(f"Current working directory: {cwd}")

# List files before scan
files_before = set(glob.glob(os.path.join(cwd, '*.nid')))
print(f"Files before scan: {len(files_before)}")

# Start scan
print("Starting scan...")
scan.StartFrameUp()  # Scanning from bottom to top

# Wait for scan to complete
scanning = scan.IsScanning
while scanning:
    remaining_lines = scan.Lines - scan.Currentline
    print(f"Scanning in progress... Remaining lines: {remaining_lines}")
    time.sleep(5)
    scanning = scan.IsScanning

print("Scanning finished!")

# Wait a moment for file to be saved
time.sleep(2)

# List files after scan
files_after = set(glob.glob(os.path.join(cwd, '*.nid')))
print(f"Files after scan: {len(files_after)}")

# Find new file
new_files = files_after - files_before
if new_files:
    image_path = list(new_files)[0]
    print(f"New image saved at: {image_path}")
else:
    print("No new .nid file found, checking all files...")
    all_files = glob.glob(os.path.join(cwd, '*.nid'))
    if all_files:
        # Get the most recent file
        image_path = max(all_files, key=os.path.getmtime)
        print(f"Most recent image: {image_path}")
    else:
        print("No .nid files found")

del spm"}</action_input>
